releases.notes:
Meteor Client addon. Drop the jar matching your Minecraft version into your
`mods` folder, next to Meteor Client itself.

Every jar is built from the same source against Mojang's official mappings.

| Minecraft | Jar |
| --- | --- |
| 1.20.1 | `new-0.72.0+mc1.20.1.jar` |
| 1.20.4 | `new-0.72.0+mc1.20.4.jar` |
| 1.21.1 | `new-0.72.0+mc1.21.1.jar` |
| 1.21.3 | `new-0.72.0+mc1.21.3.jar` |
| 1.21.4 | `new-0.72.0+mc1.21.4.jar` |
| 1.21.5 | `new-0.72.0+mc1.21.5.jar` |
| 1.21.8 | `new-0.72.0+mc1.21.8.jar` |
| 1.21.10 | `new-0.72.0+mc1.21.10.jar` |
| 1.21.11 | `new-0.72.0+mc1.21.11.jar` |
| 26.1 | `new-0.72.0+mc26.1.jar` |
| 26.1.1 | `new-0.72.0+mc26.1.1.jar` |
| 26.1.2 | `new-0.72.0+mc26.1.2.jar` |

The Baritone option needs Meteor's Baritone fork (mod id `baritone-meteor`),
not official Baritone. Without it that option simply stays idle.
